# Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air

> Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air is a HVAC Company serving Las Vegas, NV; Henderson, NV; North Las Vegas, NV.

## About

Contact Email: Info@rightonplumbing.org

## Specialties & Unique Expertise

Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air specializes in coordinated plumbing and HVAC solutions for homes and businesses across the Las Vegas Valley. Unlike contractors limited to one trade, the company holds Nevada licenses for both C-1D Plumbing and C-21B Air Conditioning, allowing it to manage projects that involve piping, water heaters, heating, and central air-conditioning systems through one provider. Its cross-trade expertise is especially useful for remodels, equipment replacements, and other projects where plumbing and climate-control systems must be planned and installed together. The company is locally owned and insured and offers free project estimates, helping Las Vegas customers evaluate both plumbing and HVAC needs without coordinating multiple contractors. Its strongest niche is providing integrated whole-home mechanical service rather than focusing only on plumbing or air conditioning.

## What Sets Us Apart

Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air stands out as a locally owned, dual-licensed contractor offering both plumbing and HVAC solutions throughout the Las Vegas Valley. With dedicated Nevada licenses for plumbing and air conditioning, the company can address multiple home-comfort systems without homeowners needing to coordinate separate contractors. Its services cover everything from plumbing and water-heater work to central air-conditioning installation and HVAC service. Free project estimates make it easier for customers to understand their options before approving a job. This broad, one-company approach is its most defensible advantage in the Las Vegas home-service market.
